recreation_entertainment_activity.label: Recreation / entertainment activity
recreation_entertainment_activity.value: Upscale casino resorts with hotel accommodations, dining, spas, and meeting and event venues in Black Hawk and Reno.

venue_service_capacity.label: Venue / service capacity
venue_service_capacity.value: Large casino floors, extensive guest rooms and suites, and banquet and meeting space at both resorts, with convention space at Atlantis.

seasonality_utilization.label: Seasonality / utilization
seasonality_utilization.value: Year-round enclosed pools at both resorts, with around-the-clock live keno at Atlantis and around-the-clock full-service dining at Black Hawk.

gaming_economics_gaming_businesses.label: Gaming economics [gaming businesses]
gaming_economics_gaming_businesses.value: Gaming floors with extensive slot offerings, table games, poker, keno, and sportsbooks. Atlantis also offers video poker and race wagering.

notes: The evidence leaves visitor volumes, membership mix, and seasonal demand uncertain.
